"""Compare retained models under the repaired runtime without querying the release holdout."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

output = Path('Evals/evidence/literal-preservation-2026-09-17.json')
record = {
    'scope': 'Controlled rejection probes and development-only model rechecks; no release holdout, M1 or full privacy pass.',
    'nativeProbes': [json.loads(l) for l in Path('.build/literal-native-results.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
    'fixtureSHA256': hashlib.sha256(Path('Evals/fixtures/literal-boundaries.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'sourceSHA256': {p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [
        'Packages/Cleanup/Sources/Cleanup/EditPlanValidator.swift', 'Evals/editplan.py',
        'Packages/Cleanup/Tests/CleanupTests/CorpusContractTests.swift', 'Scripts/test_tooling.py']},
    'logs': {name: Path('.build/'+name+'.log').read_text() for name in [
        'literal-boundaries-native-red', 'literal-boundaries-python-red',
        'literal-boundaries-native-green', 'literal-boundaries-python-green',
        'literal-full-verification', 'literal-release-build']},
    'review': {'standards': 'comparison_standards: no actionable integration findings',
               'spec': 'comparison_spec: no actionable integration findings'},
    'driverSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'models': {},
}

def retain():
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')

retain()
for label,model,previous in [
    ('composition','Models/Artifacts/composition-qwen-adapter-v2','.build/composition-adapter-reviewed-development'),
    ('low-rate','Models/Artifacts/low-rate-qwen-step600','.build/low-rate-selected-development'),
]:
    directory = Path('.build/literal-'+label+'-development')
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',
                        '.build/out/Products/Debug/PoptartCleanupEval','--model',model,
                        '--output-directory',str(directory)],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    run = {n: json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']}
    run['predictions'] = [json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    run['nativeResources'] = (directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()
    old = {r['id']:r for r in [json.loads(l) for l in (Path(previous)/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]}
    assert set(old)=={r['id'] for r in run['predictions']}
    run['changedBehaviorIDs'] = [r['id'] for r in run['predictions'] if any(
        r.get(k)!=old[r['id']].get(k) for k in ['rawModelOutput','outcome','output'])]
    record['models'][label] = run
    retain()
    print(label,run['report']['editPlanExact'],'changed',run['changedBehaviorIDs'],flush=True)
